title: helianthemum apenninum var. tomentellum
intro: Helianthemum apenninum var. tomentellum, commonly known as Alpine Rockrose, is a variety of flowering plant that belongs to the family Cistaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, such as inflammation and skin issues, due to its health benefits, which include wound healing, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Rockrose include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral effects, which help to soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of Helianthemum apenninum var. tomentellum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
